project_context.name: MASCI OPS - WP-18C9
project_context.description: Executive / PM Information Architecture & Comprehension Rebuild. Elite heavy-civil operations platform built for construction executives and project managers.

rules: NO INTER or generic sans for headings. Use Chivo for industrial, sturdy authority.
Headings > 32px MUST use tracking-tight or tracking-tighter.
Overlines and Labels MUST be uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em].
Data metrics (CPI, SPI, percentages, project numbers) MUST use IBM Plex Mono for tabular lining.
Hierarchy gap rule: Jump between heading and subheading max 2 tailwind steps.
Color is function only. 95% of UI should be structural grayscale.
Status colors MUST meet 4.5:1 contrast ratio against their backgrounds.
NEVER use pure black or pure gray. Tint neutrals slightly (e.g., Slate).
NO teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4) for dashboards.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: GRID BORDERS (The Technical Look). Expose the skeleton. Container uses border-collapse style layout. 1px solid borders, no soft or muddy shadows.
visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp edges or max 4px border-radius. Cardless, rectangular, dense styles.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Crisp -translate-y-[1px] with shadow-sm and border darkening. ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: MODE B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Tight gap-4 or gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding (p-6 or p-8) for cards with borders. Compact vertical rhythm for data rows.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Left-align all data, labels, and paragraphs. Only center specific empty states. Do not center-everything.

primary_design_standard_order: 6. WHERE CAN I OPEN THE UNDERLYING PROJECT/RECORD?

card_hierarchy.header: PROJECT NUMBER — PROJECT NAME (e.g., PRJ-942 — South River Bridge)
card_hierarchy.primary_condition: ONE Governed Project Condition (No contradictory badges).
card_hierarchy.why_explanation: Operational meaning (e.g., 'Cost performance is approximately 37% worse than plan...').

language_and_copy: BANNED: 'plain English', 'This view uses the same approved...', 'drill-back', 'reporting hierarchy', 'evidence'.
BANNED: Generic fallback identity like 'Project work'. If missing, use 'Project name unavailable' + Number.
PORTFOLIO TITLES: Exec = 'Portfolio Performance', PM = 'Your Project Portfolio'.
FILTERS: All, Critical, Needs Attention, Watch Closely, On Track, Needs Information.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border. High contrast header. NO generic 'Vercel-look' shadows.
components.badges: Solid fill or high-contrast outline. Only ONE status badge per project card.
components.navigation: Solid background, never transparent. Distinct separation from content.
components.tables: Dense, crisp lines, clear numerical alignments. Use Monospace for values.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building an elite heavy-civil operations platform. It must look rugged, technical, and precise.
Follow the WP-18C9 strict requirements exactly. Do NOT put 'On Track' and 'Needs Attention' on the same card. ONE governed status per card.
Remove any text that explains how the software works. Just show the operational data. The software architecture is never the story.
For metrics, show the operational meaning FIRST (e.g., '37% worse than plan'), then the index (CPI: 0.727) as secondary. Do not require operators to interpret SPI/CPI.
Implement a robust 'Portfolio Performance' landing page that immediately answers the Five-Second Executive Test.
Reconcile Executive surfaces logically: Executive Overview (high-level), Operations Command Center (immediate incidents), Portfolio Performance (cross-project intelligence).
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them to remove the default look. Make them flatter, sharper, more industrial.
Ensure all interactive elements and key informational elements have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., data-testid='filter-critical').
universal_guidelines: DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, overlays, or headers.
DO NOT use universal 'transition: all'. Apply transitions to specific properties only.
DO NOT center-align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is strictly banned).
Ensure focus states have higher contrast.
Prioritize optical alignment over geometrical alignment.
Use sonner for toasts. Customize scrollbars to have no gutter.
Never use generic AI emojis (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons. Use lucide-react.
